context.person: A person using a mobile news application
context.user_goal: Review or reverse the application-only preference at any time.

product_state.preceding_state: The person turned on reduced motion inside the application.
product_state.current_state: Large page transitions stop immediately. Essential loading indicators remain.
known_facts: The setting affects only this application.
The device-level motion preference is unchanged.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product confirmation so the person can understand reduced motion preference confirmed, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Turn application motion effects back on.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The application changes nonessential motion while preserving status feedback.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review or reverse the application-only preference at any time.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
